questionnaire.title: Health Questionnaire
questionnaire.subtitle: About 6 minutes. Answers save automatically, so you can stop any time.
questionnaire.loadError: We couldn't load your saved answers, so editing is paused to keep them safe. Try again in a moment.

errors.range: Please enter a value between {{min}} and {{max}}.
errors.fixBelow: A few answers need attention before you continue.
errors.date: Please enter a real date that isn't in the future.

review.title: You're all set
review.subtitle: Here's what your answers unlock. You can edit any section at any time.
review.dashboardNote: Your scores are calculated on the Dashboard and update when you change an answer.

about.title: About you
about.description: The basics every score is built on.

vitals.title: Vitals & lab values
vitals.description: Recent readings or blood test results. Skip anything you don't know; you can add it later.

mental.title: Mental wellbeing
mental.description: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?

sleep.title: Sleep
sleep.description: Snoring, tiredness and how long you sleep.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Wearables you'd like to connect when syncing arrives.

dateOfBirth.label: What is your date of birth?
dateOfBirth.help: Every risk score depends on age.

riskSex.label: Which sex should we use for risk calculations?
riskSex.help: The medical risk models were built from male and female data. Choose the one that best matches your body; it's only used for calculations.

country.label: Which country do you live in?
country.help: Heart risk is calibrated for your region of the world.

waist.label: What is your waist size?
waist.help: Measure around your belly at the level of your belly button. Used for diabetes risk and body shape.

neck.label: What is your neck size?
neck.help: Measure around the middle of your neck. Used for the sleep apnea check.

dailyActivity.label: Do you get at least 30 minutes of physical activity on most days?
dailyActivity.help: Walking, chores, work and exercise all count.

fruitVeg.label: Do you eat vegetables, fruit or berries every day?

exerciseFrequency.label: How often do you exercise on purpose?

auditFrequency.label: How often do you have a drink containing alcohol?

auditTypical.label: How many standard drinks containing alcohol do you have on a typical day?
auditTypical.help: One standard drink is about a small glass of wine, a small beer or a single shot of spirits.

auditBinge.label: How often do you have six or more drinks on one occasion?

conditions.label: Has a doctor ever told you that you have any of these?

bpMedication.label: Do you take medicine for high blood pressure?

statin.label: Do you take a statin or other cholesterol-lowering medicine?

highGlucoseHistory.label: Have you ever been told your blood sugar was high?
highGlucoseHistory.help: For example at a check-up, during an illness or during pregnancy.

familyDiabetes.label: Has anyone in your family had diabetes?

parentsHypertension.label: Do your parents have high blood pressure?

pregnancies.label: How many times have you been pregnant?
pregnancies.help: Only used by the experimental diabetes estimate.

medications.label: Which medicines do you take regularly?

systolic.label: Blood pressure: top number (systolic)
systolic.help: The higher number of a reading like 120/80. Needed for heart and blood pressure risk.

egfr.label: eGFR (kidney function)
egfr.help: Shown on most blood test reports. If you only know your creatinine, enter that instead.

phq1.label: Feeling nervous, anxious or on edge

phq2.label: Not being able to stop or control worrying

phq3.label: Little interest or pleasure in doing things

snoring.label: Do you snore loudly?
snoring.help: Loud enough to be heard through a closed door, or your partner nudges you for snoring.

tired.label: Do you often feel tired, fatigued or sleepy during the day?

observedApnea.label: Has anyone seen you stop breathing, choke or gasp while you sleep?

sleepHours.label: How many hours do you usually sleep?

lastCheckup.label: When was your last health check-up?

vaccinations.label: Are your vaccinations up to date?

dental.label: Do you see a dentist at least once a year?

trackCycle.label: Would you like to track your menstrual cycle?

lastPeriod.label: When did your last period start?

cycleLength.label: How long is your cycle usually?

wearable.label: Do you use a smartwatch or fitness tracker?

wantsSync.label: Would you like to connect it when syncing becomes available?

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your profile, preferences and data.

profile.title: Profile
profile.displayNameHelp: Shown in the header and on your Dashboard.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.languageHelp: More languages are on the way.
preferences.mlModelHelp: Experimental. Trained only on data from women of Pima heritage, so it may not apply to you.

data.title: Your data
data.pdfHelp: A personalised summary of your results, plus a detail page for your doctor.
data.jsonHelp: Everything HealthNet has saved for you, in a machine-readable file.

account.title: Account
account.resetHelp: We'll email you a link to set a new password.
account.googleManaged: You sign in with Google, so your password is managed in your Google account.
account.deleteHelp: Permanently delete your account and all saved health data.
account.deleteWarning: This deletes your account, questionnaire answers and results for good. It can't be undone.
account.deleteGoogleNote: You'll be asked to confirm with your Google account.

errors.popupClosed: The confirmation window was closed before finishing.
errors.userMismatch: Please confirm with the same Google account you signed in with.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.dataNotDeleted: Your saved data couldn't be deleted, so your account was kept. Please try again.

dashboard.title: Health Dashboard
dashboard.welcome: Welcome back, {{name}}! Here is what your answers say about your health.

risk.title: Your health risk scores
risk.subtitle: Calculated from your questionnaire answers with published, validated risk models.

empty.title: Your scores will appear here
empty.body: Answer the health questionnaire and HealthNet will estimate your heart, blood pressure and diabetes risk, plus quick checks for mood, sleep and alcohol.

errors.unavailable: Couldn't reach the HealthNet risk service. Make sure the API is running (python main.py in FINAL YEAR PROJECT) and try again.
errors.notConfigured: The risk service isn't ready to check sign-ins yet. Set FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID for the API and restart it.
errors.auth: Your sign-in could not be confirmed. Please sign out and sign in again.
errors.invalid: Some of your answers could not be used. Please review the questionnaire.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while calculating your scores.

risk.whoRegion: Calibrated for your region of the world
risk.framinghamOptimal: Someone your age with ideal blood pressure and weight: {{value}}%
risk.findriscRisk: About {{risk}} people with this score develop type 2 diabetes within 10 years

diabetesModel.label: Diabetes model
diabetesModel.experimentalNote: Experimental: trained on one population of women, with some inputs estimated. Use FINDRISC for a validated score.

reasons.existingCvd: Not used for people who already have heart disease or have had a stroke; your doctor will assess your risk directly.
reasons.unknownCountry: We don't have regional data for your country yet.
reasons.outOfRange: Your {{field}} is outside the range this model was built for ({{min}}–{{max}}).
reasons.alreadyHypertension: You already have high blood pressure or take medicine for it, so this score doesn’t apply.
reasons.highReading: Your blood pressure reading is already at or above {{systolic}}/{{diastolic}}. Please talk to a doctor or nurse.
reasons.diabetes: This score is for people without diabetes.
reasons.alreadyDiabetes: You already have diabetes, so this risk score doesn’t apply.
reasons.womenOnly: Only available for women, because the model was trained on data from women.

assumptions.diabetesFromLabs: Counted as diabetes because your HbA1c or fasting glucose is in the diabetes range.
assumptions.statinAssumedNo: You weren’t sure about statins, so we assumed you don’t take one.
assumptions.parentsAssumedNone: You weren’t sure about your parents’ blood pressure, so we assumed neither has it.
assumptions.fastingGlucoseForOgtt: Uses fasting glucose where the model expects a 2-hour glucose test.
assumptions.skinInsulinImputed: Skin thickness and insulin are filled in with typical values.
assumptions.pedigreeFromFamilyHistory: Family history is estimated from your answer.

support.title: You don’t have to handle this alone
support.body: Your answers suggest you may be dealing with anxiety or low mood. Talking to a doctor, counsellor or someone you trust can really help.
support.helplines: Find a free, confidential helpline in your country
support.emergency: If you are in danger or thinking about harming yourself, call your local emergency number now.

risk.disclaimer: These are educational estimates from published risk models, not a diagnosis. Talk to a doctor or nurse about your results before making health decisions.

vitals.title: Your latest readings
vitals.subtitle: From the Vitals & lab values section of your questionnaire.
